descriptionHtml:
Bug B25 · P1 · known

The Nursing Home dashboard counts every resident (22, should be the 19 In Today); a resident taken off In Today is still on it

Tickets: TFA-92587 AC6 ready for qa; TFA-92598 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-20/S04a, TC-20/S06, TC-20/S07

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S09 In Today × rounding status → Nursing Home dashboard counts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 'In Today' drives the dashboard counts: the Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard counts only the residents marked In Today. (The dashboard tabs and whether the counts follow the tab are TC-20 U3, gated on … (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 How it works 6; TFA-92598 AC 4 (same rule))

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fixture resident (In Today, pending) plus QA Kale (In Today, pending), QA Larch (In Today, complete), QA Maple (not In Today, pre-rounded), QA Nettle (not In Today, complete)

When Open the Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard; go back, mark QA Maple In Today from All Residents, open the dashboard again; go back, un-mark QA Kale, open the dashboard again

Then Counts cover only residents marked In Today. First Total 3 / Pending 2 / In Progress 0 / Complete 1. After marking Maple: 4 / 2 / 1 / 1. After un-marking Kale: 3 / 1 / 1 / 1. QA Nettle is never counted

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The four numbers under 'Rounding status counts' on each checkpoint equal the expected row of the table (`counts`, same key as TC-20 S03). Judged against UAT TC-09 and TFA-92587 AC 6, which is ready for qa: a mismatch is a Fail on TFA-92587, reported as Fail (known) because the ticket snapshot already records that roundingDashboard.ts loads view 'all' on e02167f. …

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-92598 in progress

The Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard counts every resident (Total 22 instead of 19), and marking or un-marking In Today does not change the counts.

Evidence: allure 915dd492, datasets lane marked known. A matrix knownGap sits on every check: roundingDashboard.ts loads view 'all' (TFA-92587 AC 6 / TFA-92598 AC 4, Q4). Also dev report §4 bullet 1, and ledger U57 (same on dev) and U69.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
